Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prompted demo: Acme Analytics — quick intro and next steps

Hi Emily —

I noticed your account hit one of our usage thresholds this week (nice work!) and wanted to see if you'd be open to a short 30-min demo to walk through how other teams at companies like Acme Analytics use Redwood to get predictable inference performance and lower per-token costs. No pressure — just a quick product walkthrough and Q&A.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue, Mar 10 — 10:00 AM or 2:00 PM
- Wed, Mar 11 — 11:00 AM

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick intros (5m)
- Live walkthrough of deployment options + cost-control features (15m)
- Next steps & technical checklist (10m)

If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/camila-30m

Quick background: I'm on the SDR team and will loop in your AE for any follow-ups.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachment: none

Thanks,
Emily
